Variables

pydantic model dakota.spec.variables.VariablesConfig

Specifies the parameter set to be iterated by a particular method.

Show JSON schema
{
   "title": "VariablesConfig",
   "description": "Specifies the parameter set to be iterated by a particular method.",
   "type": "object",
   "properties": {
      "id_variables": {
         "anyOf": [
            {
               "type": "string"
            },
            {
               "type": "null"
            }
         ],
         "default": null,
         "description": "Name the variables block; helpful when there are multiple",
         "title": "Id Variables",
         "x-materialization": [
            {
               "ir_key": "variables.id",
               "ir_value_type": "String",
               "storage_type": "DIRECT_VALUE"
            }
         ]
      },
      "active": {
         "anyOf": [
            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/ActiveAll"
            },
            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/Design"
            },
            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/Uncertain"
            },
            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/Aleatory"
            },
            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/Epistemic"
            },
            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/State"
            },
            {
               "type": "null"
            }
         ],
         "default": null,
         "description": "Set the active variables view a method will see",
         "title": "Active",
         "x-union-pattern": 2
      },
      "domain": {
         "anchor": true,
         "anyOf": [
            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/Mixed"
            },
            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/Relaxed"
            },

               "type": "null"

      },

            {
               "$ref": "#/$defs/ContinuousDesign"
